title: What OUTSIDE should learn next
intro: Evolution compares the external security world with OUTSIDE's current coverage and proposes evidence-backed detector additions for actively exploited vulnerabilities.
safety: Every proposal is a draft awaiting founder approval. Evolution prepares changes but never applies, merges or deploys them on its own.
allCovered: Every exploited CVE on a fingerprinted technology is already correlated.
notSynced: The KEV catalogue has not synced yet — proposals appear once it does.
proposalSummary: CISA KEV evidence links {cve} to a technology that OUTSIDE fingerprints but does not yet correlate.
proposedChange: Prepare a reviewable detector entry for {cve}; no code or infrastructure is changed automatically.
needsYou: Needs you: review the generated entry and confirm the affected version ranges.
draftNote: This is a reviewable draft only. Human validation, tests, commit and deployment remain required.
approveHint: Approve → prepares a reviewable draft · never auto-applied
reliabilityBody: Feedback bounds noisy detectors on future scans without silencing or inflating them. Clearing the feedback restores full trust.
